main_surface_invariants.interpretation: Certificate concerns the region with absolute winding number one against this closed oriented triangle surface; it does not approve production anatomy or global embedding.

method: Every selected source vertex: generalized winding number against dominant closed oriented triangle cycle, |w| near1. Every selected triangle versus EVERY dominant triangle: AABB gap certificate or interval/error-guarded separating-axis projection certificate with Euclidean separation lower bound greater than margin. No nearest-neighbor sampling and no broad-phase candidate pairs dropped without a gap certificate. Additionally every selected vertex has exact-binary rational odd ray parity, with all geometric intersection decisions performed by Python arbitrary-precision integers.
numerical_guard: Source POSITION float32 values read exactly into float64. Projection dot bounds use outward-rounded gamma8 error intervals. Arbitrary computed nonzero axes suffice to establish separation; axis accuracy relative to a mathematical normal is not required. Normal lengths rounded conservatively upward. Strict margin=source scale*1e-7 exceeds float64 operation error.
triangle_interior_argument: A selected triangle is connected. Its vertices lie in the winding-one region and its entire surface is strictly separated from all dominant triangles. Winding cannot change across any continuous path on that triangle without crossing the dominant surface, so every point of the triangle stays in the same interior region.
scope_limit: Proof supports a separately reviewed diagnostic candidate removing only the listed interior surface fragments. It does not prove dominant-mesh global self-intersection absence, production topology, hair/eye/hand fidelity, rig readiness or game approval. Original mesh remains intact.

exact_ray_parity.method: Exact integer ray/triangle orientation, barycentric-sign and ray-depth tests on original binary float32 coordinates. Each finite float is converted by as_integer_ratio to a common power-of-two denominator. Rays have exact integer directions (1,dy,dz). Odd positive-ray crossing parity classifies strict interior; exact edge/vertex/coplanar contact triggers another integer direction. Broad-phase candidate exclusion uses conservative float64 projection intervals, not approximate intersection signs.
